allocation_semantics: Preflight frame count, composition range, platform length and exactly frame_count*4 output bytes before allocation. Quantization then validates each exact value while writing a private buffer; invalid input discards that buffer. Caller-owned exact samples are excluded. Arithmetic reuses one fixed-count big.Int scratch set bounded by max_exact_bits. Exact's public accessors also create bounded defensive numerator and denominator copies per channel; these are transient and never retained. Output owns one complete byte buffer; Bytes returns a copy and WriteCanonical passes only fixed 64 KiB defensive scratch chunks to external writers, so no accessor exposes the mutable backing storage.
byte_semantics: Serialize each signed sample as its two's-complement uint16 bit pattern in little-endian order, frame-major with left then right, with no header, padding or trailing bytes.
cancellation_semantics: Validate context before work; check cancellation at bounded intervals while validating and converting samples, while hashing output bytes and immediately before publication. Failure returns no Result or partial PCM block.
channel_semantics: Every input frame is exact stereo in [left,right] order. Output is exactly two channels in interleaved [FL,FR] order; no channel inference, rematrixing or mono fold-down occurs.
clipping_semantics: Independently clamp each exact input channel to the closed nominal-full-scale interval [-1,1] before integer conversion. This is the only saturation in the profile and is not a dynamics processor or true-peak limiter.
excluded_responsibilities: Source decode, sample-rate conversion, retime, channel mapping, gain, pan, bus mixing, limiter behavior, loudness, true-peak processing, WAV/container headers, codec encoding, encoder delay, priming and publication are outside this profile.
hash_semantics: The canonical hash is SHA-256 over only the complete interleaved PCM bytes. The containing result/evidence manifest must separately bind profile, sample rate, first composition sample and frame count.
placement_semantics: Sample rate must be positive. Negative first composition samples are valid, frame count is non-negative, and the half-open composition sample range [first,first+frame_count) must have an int64-representable exclusive end.
rounding_semantics: Round the complete exact scaled rational once to the nearest integer; an exact half chooses the even integer. Apply no float conversion, intermediate rounding, noise shaping or dither.
scaling_semantics: Multiply each clamped exact rational by 32768. Negative full scale maps to -32768; positive full scale rounds to 32768 and is then saturated to the largest signed 16-bit value 32767.
